question: Analyze viral load (log10) measured weekly over 6 weeks in HIV patients on two drug regimens. Fit a linear mixed-effects model with fixed effects for time and treatment, and random intercepts for subject. Test for treatment-by-time interaction and report p-value and marginal R^2.

files.eval_guideline: Marginal R^2 must match within 1% relative absolute error; Interaction_P_Value must be significant (below 0.05); column order and header labels may differ.
